meta.one_mistake_recovery: paired by (level, deck, scenario, seed): recoveries_after_mistake / eligible_mistake_games; eligible = planner won and a semantically different, strictly lower-scored mistake was injected; pooled over the level
meta.legacy_index_note: difficulty_index_p10_di_1 uses the unconditional planner-one-mistake win rate; kept only for comparison
meta.weighting: every (scenario, deck) cell of a level has equal weight
meta.solver: separate offline command game:solve (P10-1); planner results are not a solvability proof
meta.level_phase_metrics: per cell: reach_rate = games whose run entered the act / games (act 1 = 1.0); avg_entry_turn = mean first turn played in the act among games that reached it
